responsibility: Go-specific GCC driver logic that rewrites the command line before compilation and linking. It decides when Go input implies linking against libgo, libgobegin, pthread, math, and shared libgcc; handles `-static-libgo`, split-stack support, profiling variants, default `-g1`, and synthesized `-o` output names so multiple `.go` files are compiled as one package; and preserves or reorders relevant libraries, making it the policy file for how the `gccgo` driver invokes the rest of GCC and the linker.
